# Sustainable Sushi

> > Comprehensive resource for sustainable seafood choices, ocean conservation, and the health impacts of fish consumption.

Sustainable Sushi provides evidence-based guidance on selecting environmentally responsible seafood, understanding marine conservation issues, and navigating the health benefits and risks of fish consumption. The site covers sustainability certifications like MSC, fishing practices, mercury and PCB concerns, omega-3 benefits, and Japanese sushi culture.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable seafood
- Marine conservation
- Ocean sustainability
- Marine Stewardship Council (MSC)
- Seafood health
- Mercury in fish
- PCBs
- Omega-3 fatty acids
- Fish nutrition
- Food safety
- Sushi and sashimi
- Fishing practices
- Japanese cuisine
- Casson Trenor
- Andre Alexander

## Core Resources

- [Sustainable Sushi - Your Sustainable Fish & Seafood Resource](https://sustainablesushi.net): Homepage: sustainable seafood guide covering fish, health, and recipes
- [Sustainability - Sustainable Sushi](https://sustainablesushi.net/sustainability): Ocean conservation, fishing practices, MSC certification, marine issues
- [Health - Sustainable Sushi](https://sustainablesushi.net/health): Health benefits & risks of seafood: mercury, PCBs, omega-3, food safety
